# Local map assets

- china-map-geojson.js: generated from china-map-geojson@1.0.4 (ISC) for offline China/province GeoJSON rendering.
- east-asia-neighbors.js: generated by scripts/generate-neighbor-map.js from world-atlas@2.0.2 (ISC), derived from Natural Earth via TopoJSON, for offline surrounding country context.
- ../echarts/echarts.min.js: copied from echarts@6.1.0 (Apache-2.0).

Runtime map rendering must not call online map APIs.
